description.stages: Add stages with their tasks from a spreadsheet. Nothing is saved until every row is valid.
description.materials: Add materials from a spreadsheet. Rooms, stages and suppliers are matched by name. Nothing is saved until every row is valid.
description.contacts: Add people to your address book from a spreadsheet. Nothing is saved until every row is valid.

pick.label: Spreadsheet file
pick.hint: CSV or XLSX, up to 5 MB. The first row holds the column names.

stagesHelp: One line per task. A line with a stage name starts a stage. Lines with the same name, or none, add tasks to it.

fileErrors.too_large: That file is larger than 5 MB.
fileErrors.unreadable: The file couldn't be read. Check that it isn't damaged or password-protected.

map.title: Match the columns
map.description: We matched {{file}} by column name. Check each field and fix any that are wrong.

preview.title: Check the rows
preview.summaryStages: {{stages}} stages with {{tasks}} tasks are ready to import.
preview.problems_one: {{count}} problem to fix in the file before importing.
preview.problems_other: {{count}} problems to fix in the file before importing.
preview.problemsHint: Fix them in your spreadsheet, then pick the file again.
preview.summaryContacts_one: {{count}} contact is ready to import. Contacts already in your address book (same email) are matched, not duplicated.
preview.summaryContacts_other: {{count}} contacts are ready to import. Contacts already in your address book (same email) are matched, not duplicated.

issues.dates_differ: doesn't match the dates of the stage above
issues.task_without_stage: has a task but no stage above it
issues.invalid_status: isn't a status (planned, ordered, delivered or installed)
issues.invalid_unit: is too long for a unit
issues.invalid_kind: isn't a kind (client, crew, supplier, architect or other)
issues.duplicate_in_file: appears more than once in the file

done.contactsHint: Updated: an existing contact with the same email got its empty fields filled in. Skipped: nothing new to add.

errors.notReady: Fix the problems in the file first.
errors.rowsRejected: The project rejected some rows. Nothing was imported.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
errors.rowsRejectedContacts: The address book rejected some rows. Nothing was imported.

contactsHelp: Phone numbers need a country code (+48 600 100 200); a plain 9-digit number is read as Polish. A contact whose email is already in your address book isn't duplicated: only its empty fields are filled in, and nothing is overwritten. A row with no email is skipped when the same name and phone already exist.
